name: HUB24 Regional QLD Technology Scholarship (UQ)
summary: Scholarship for first- or second-year UQ computer science and IT students from regional Queensland high schools facing financial hardship.
who: Domestic student who can demonstrate financial hardship (Centrelink statements, ATO notice, etc.).
In first or second year of the Bachelor of Computer Science, Bachelor of Information Technology, or a dual including one of these.
Completed Year 12 or secondary studies at a regional high school, or as a boarder with a permanent regional address, within the stated recent period.
how: Apply using the online application portal with a cover letter, resume, Year 12 or studies report, and evidence of financial hardship.
